title: Configure the colors of the grid and the size of the text?
description:
Super nice script!

Is it possible to configure the colors of the grid and the size of the text? I find the contrast to be a bit low when priniting and I cannot figure out how to adjust it.

Got claude.ai to suggest the following that works reasonably well, but it would be nice to have this built in.

```
library(ggweekly)
library(ggplot2)

# Create the base calendar
p <- ggweek_planner(
    start_day = "2024-07-05", 
    end_day = "2024-09-01",
    month_color = "black",
    day_number_color = "black",
    weekend_fill = "#f0f0f0",
    day_number_text_size = 3,
    month_text_size = 5,
    highlight_text_size = 3
)

# Add thicker grid lines
p + 
    theme(
        text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        panel.grid = element_blank()
    ) +
    # Add vertical lines (excluding the outer lines)
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1:6 + 0.5, color = "black", size = 0.5) +
    # Add horizontal lines (excluding the outer lines)
    geom_hline(yintercept = seq(1.5, 25.5, by = 1), color = "black", size = 0.5)

```

title: Cannot create planner with only 2 weeks
description:
First of all, thanks for the great package! I am, however, running into an issue when the length of the planner is quite short (e.g., less than three weeks). I've included a reprex below.

``` r
# Load library
library(ggweekly)

# 49 days from today
ggweek_planner(
  start_day = Sys.Date(),
  end_day = Sys.Date() + 49
)
```

title: setting locale
description:
I'm a spanish native speaker and I've been looking for a way to set locale inside `ggweek_planer()`.  This worked for me:

```r
library(ggweekly)

Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "es_PE.UTF8")

ggweek_planner(
  start_day = "2020-06-01", 
  end_day = "2020-07-31", 
  holidays = NULL
)
```
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/19418298/74752151-40638200-523c-11ea-8811-534a907fa941.png)

But I think it would be nice to be able to do it inside the call to `ggweek_planer()`
